app.name: Handball AI

calibrate.existing: Orange: the automatically detected court. If it is wrong, set the points again.
calibrate.error: The points could not be saved. Please try again.
calibrate.hint: Tip: court corners and goal posts on the floor are the most precise. To move a point, choose it in the sketch and click again.

landmarks.sixRightNear: Right 6 m line, end camera side
